#152 round-5 deadline closure: explicitly skipped, not extended

Request 01a1b773-a14f-77f1-9c53-5ef80a9ee5a3 concerned head 65fc109ffc83dd4244aa6dd9f04a8ba1840d3ec5. The PM explicitly instructed skipping round 5 in message 114851c668362931-0000000000000009: it was superseded by round 6 at 02f27aabf2a58f94d1383846fc1ad40b4d72ddf5.

Round 5 was never reviewed and has no reviewer verdict. The authorized round-6 delta review completed PASS-WITH-NOTES at 02f27aabf2a58f94d1383846fc1ad40b4d72ddf5: comment 6712368045, writer commit 67b74fdaac3cf6910c8221446138d20d5015338b. That verdict answers its separate request 01a1b78a-df78-7982-984b-e7cbf21ef606, as verified in the persisted metadata. The exact-head index contains the final reviewer, security and performance verdicts.

The superseded round-5 request was not correlated when skipped, leaving its deadline open. This note answers only that old request; it does not assign a verdict to 65fc109, broaden the round-6 review scope, reopen #152 or extend its limit. No longer review period is needed. No review is currently in flight; await a fresh authorized packet.
